description: GPT-5.6 Luna's check-and-repair loop at xhigh on tree-sitter (incremental parsing library for building syntax-aware programming tools, written in Rust): 5 loop runs of up to 50 rounds. Compared with the single GPT-5.6 Sol workers of sol-xhigh-tree-sitter-single at their mean model cost (bench parity) and at their mean score (bench match), and with the prompted single sessions of luna-xhigh-tree-sitter-prompt.

task.adjustments_rationale: The reference moves to a root-owned directory outside the workspace (the task statement points there), so builders cannot overwrite or delete it at the build target's path. This adjustment is general, not specific to the task. The bundled documentation is left as shipped: no task-specific corrections.
